{{Quote|Sorry, Commander, but you're on your own for now! We've been ambushed and can't bring up support!''"<br />"''No need to explain, Sergeant! I think we're ''all'' on the same wavelength!|The clone sergeant and Plo Koon|<ref name="mm" />}}
A '''clone trooper sergeant''' was stationed in [[Timira City]] on [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He helped defend the [[Jedi Research Facility]] from an [[Korasa job|attack]] by [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] seeking the [[Blade of Beginnings]].
